title: fix(plugin-grid): inline cells read the record-grained update verdict the row kebab reads
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ88z34ttNLNf2N8f3PHSjhj7)_
Fixes #27365

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:列表行内编辑现在按「这一行」的服务端写权限判定;服务端拒绝的行点不开单元格编辑器,和该行的 ⋮ 菜单给出同一个答案。
- 为什么改:对象级有编辑权、但共享/归属/RLS 拒绝某行时,⋮ 菜单已隐藏「编辑」,单元格却仍可编辑,保存时被服务端整单拒绝。
- 风险与回滚:只收窄不放宽;没拿到行级答案(未返回、请求失败、行无 id)时保持原行为。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`(`isRowEditable` 与 `update: canEdit || inlineEditable`)、`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`(`rowMayEdit`)、`ui/packages/types/src/data-display.ts`(新运行时槽位)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/inlineEditRecordVerdict-27365.test.tsx`,预期 8 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

An inline-editable grid gated its cells on the object-level affordance only (`inlineEditable`), while the row kebab on the same rows also read the server's record-grained `update` verdict (`useRecordCrudVerdicts`). A row refused by sharing, ownership or RLS lost Edit from its kebab but still opened a cell editor, and the save was refused whole. Now the cells read the same verdict.

- `@object-ui/types`: `DataTableSchema` declares a new runtime slot, `isRowEditable?: (row: any) => boolean`. The zod mirror refuses it by name (`handlerKeyRefusal`, `runtime-slot`), like `renderCellEditor` and `rowGroups`. The ledgers move with it: the `KnownDrift` entry for `data-display.zod.ts#DataTableSchema` gains the key (51 entries, 88 keys), and the read lists in the `body`/`children` tombstones name it.
- `@object-ui/components`: `data-table` reads `isRowEditable` through one `rowMayEdit(row)` check in `startEdit` (the door click, double-click and Enter all pass through), in the Enter key path, and in the per-cell `isEditable`. A refused row reads like a row of a read-only table: no editor, no edit cursor, and a click reaches the row's own click handler. With the slot absent, every row behaves as before.
- `@object-ui/plugin-grid`: `ObjectGrid` supplies `isRowEditable` as `resolveRowRecordCrudAffordance(inlineEditable, recordVerdict(rowRecordId(row), 'update'))`, the exact accessor the kebab reads. It asks the batched probe whenever the grid is inline-editable (`update: canEdit || inlineEditable`), so an editable grid whose kebab offers no Edit is narrowed too. That is still one probe, read by both affordances, with no second evaluator (ruling 6457467702 B).
- ListView reaches the cells through `ObjectGrid` (`type: 'object-grid'`, `editable: inlineEdit && inlineEditOffered`), so it has no separate door and needs no plugin-list change.
- Test doubles: editable-grid suites now get the explain probe. Nine plugin-grid suites and one app-shell suite (`ListView.gridRowColorSelect-12393`) answer it from an explain double instead of reaching the network. This is test-only, per claim amendment 6487558539. The assertions are unchanged.

## Why

The card: one grid gave two answers for one row. Fail-open is preserved exactly as the `useRecordCrudVerdicts` docblock requires: an unknown verdict keeps the object-level behaviour.

## Tests

- `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/inlineEditRecordVerdict-27365.test.tsx` (8): a refused row opens no editor on click or Enter and shows no edit cursor. CONTROLs: an allowed row stays editable; a non-OK response, a network failure, a response with no `records[]`, and the pre-answer window all keep the row editable. The kebab and the cells agree on both rows from ONE `update` probe. An editable grid with no kebab Edit still asks and still narrows.
- `components/src/__tests__/data-table-row-editable-27365.test.tsx` (7): the seam on its own covers click, double-click and Enter, a click that reaches `onRowClick`, an allowed-row control, the no-predicate control, and narrows-only.
- `types/src/__tests__/data-table-declared-keys-6882.test.ts`: the declared exact shape, a widened-return control (`@ts-expect-error`), and the zod mirror refusing an authored `isRowEditable` by name.

## Acceptance notes

- Ablation 1, ObjectGrid's per-row read replaced by `(_row: any) => true` via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: 4 of 8 tests in the new grid suite red (the repro, agreement, no-kebab and pre-answer legs). Restored blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Ablation 2, data-table's `rowMayEdit` replaced by `() => true`: 3 of 7 tests in the seam suite red (click, double-click, Enter). Restored blob equals HEAD.
- `ui/apps/site` was retired on main. After merging main, an ignored leftover directory (node_modules) in the worktree reddened `quick-reference-commands-4149` locally. That was a local-state artifact only: the test is green once the leftover is removed, and nothing in the tree changed.

- Before the merge, at `e77abe74` plus the doubles: `packages/plugin-grid/`, `packages/types/` and the data-table suites went 934/935 files green with one skipped; the 9 red files were the network-escape suites that now carry the double (46/46). Across 59 ui consumer suites that render an editable grid, 58 were green and the app-shell one was fixed (2/2).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 168 passed, 2 skipped, 1 red on a stale ignored `ui/apps/site` leftover. That test is green (10/10) once the leftover is removed.
